articles.title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant said large XRP spot orders point to "quiet accumulation" rather than a breakout, while ether’s price below realized value leaves holders underwater and gives it the strongest valuation case among BTC, ETH and XRP.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Jim Cramer Sells His Bitcoin Over Quantum Fears
articles.snippet: The last time he sold was in December 2022 with Bitcoin at $16,800. Will Jim's sales mark the bottom again?

articles.title: Jim Cramer Is Selling His Bitcoin Over Quantum Threat—Crypto Twitter Is Thrilled
articles.snippet: The CNBC host announced the decision on air after interviewing IBM CEO Arvind Krishna, asking him whether quantum computers could eventually crack the cryptography protecting his coins.
